SUMMARY Management at Palo Alto Networks, Inc. ( PANW +1.12% ) reported fiscal 2026 results centered on platformization adoption and demand for security systems compatible with artificial intelligence. The company reported reaching a $21.2 billion remaining performance obligation threshold while integrating two large acquisitions in identity security and observability. Management stated that the transition from individual product sales to unified platform contracts has resulted in increased contract sizes and net revenue retention exceeding 120% among platformized customers. Nikesh Arora noted the impact of autonomous AI agents on security: "We are now securing a whole new castle of machine identities with autonomous permissions." Management reported that agentic traffic within the SASE platform has increased ninefold over the last nine months. Arora stated that "platformization is the only viable strategy for real time defense" as organizations move AI initiatives into full-scale production. The company finalized the acquisition of Console, an AI-first platform intended to enable agentic workflows across enterprise operations. A large LLM customer migration to Chronosphere provided a nine-figure benefit to net new ARR during the fourth quarter. Arora indicated that the company can "build signatures for OT vulnerabilities and open source vulnerabilities and deploy them in under 4 hours." Integration synergy targets for the identity security business are currently three to six months ahead of schedule. INDUSTRY GLOSSARY NGS ARR : Next-Generation Security Annualized Recurring Revenue, representing revenue from modern product, subscription, and support offerings. RPO : Remaining Performance Obligations, a measure of contracted revenue that has not yet been recognized. XSIAM : Extended Security Intelligence and Automation Management, a platform used for security operations and telemetry. SASE : Secure Access Service Edge, a framework combining network security with wide area networking. Idira : The rebranded identity security platform following the acquisition of CyberArk. Agentic AI : Autonomous AI agents capable of executing complex workflows without direct human intervention. Prisma AIRS : AI Runtime Security, a platform designed to protect AI applications and data. OT : Operational Technology, the hardware and software used to control industrial equipment and processes. SD-WAN : Software-Defined Wide Area Network, used to manage and optimize network connections.
